This file makes the gate runnable on boltons so a reader with a key can produce a reproducible figure; a run against it is a new experiment with its own date, not a replication of the old one.

patterns.name: container-mirror
patterns.description: parallel implementations across dictutils, listutils and setutils that deliberately mirror each other's API so the containers are learnable as a set; the resemblance is the design

patterns.name: stdlib-shim
patterns.description: backports and compatibility shims that reimplement a standard-library shape on purpose, so a caller can use one name across versions

patterns.name: independent-utility
patterns.description: the library's organising principle: modules are standalone by design and may repeat a small helper rather than import across module boundaries, which is why boltons reads zero cycles
